projects.description: An end-to-end AI platform that predicts Ethiopian house prices with an interactive analytics dashboard and REST API backend.

Interactive analytics dashboard
REST API integrated with PostgreSQL
Docker-ready deployment architecture

projects.title: Moodle Customized Learning Management System

Configured course structures, user roles, and reporting
Extended features for institution-specific academic operations

projects.title: Mall Customer Segmentation

Built data pipelines for preprocessing and visualization

projects.title: Spam Email Detection
projects.description: A text classification system designed to detect spam emails using NLP techniques and machine learning models.

projects.title: AI Tax Risk Prediction
projects.description: A data-driven risk scoring solution for identifying suspicious tax-related activity using ETL pipelines and predictive modeling.

projects.title: QR Scanner Mobile App
projects.description: Enterprise mobile application used for secure invoice validation through REST APIs with offline support and optimized camera scanning.
highlights: Scans QR codes to fetch and validate invoice details

projects.title: TIN Validator Mobile App
projects.description: A tax identification number validator integrated with government systems for rapid verification and audit support.
